title: Tech Note: Build a Web Service Iteratively (XML-JSON)

historical_commentary.text: Only a short teaser is available for this note, but based on its stated approach — 4D Tags and XML-template-driven EXPORT DATA for generating dynamic XML/JSON documents — this reflects pre-native-JSON tooling. 4D has since added first-class JSON parsing/generation commands and an ORDA-based REST layer, making hand-built 4D Tags/XML-template document generation largely unnecessary for new data-publishing services.
related_updates: Native 4D JSON commands and the ORDA-based REST server (4D v16 R5+) which directly produce/consume JSON without XML templating or 4D Tags
